description: Client-side script for the 'Cost Center' doctype in ERPNext, managing form behaviors such as queries, buttons, and conversions.

methods.name: update_cost_center_number
methods.description: Opens a dialog to update the cost center's name and number, and calls server method to save changes.

methods.name: parent_cost_center
methods.description: Checks if company is entered before setting parent cost center.

methods.name: hide_unhide_group_ledger
methods.description: Adds buttons to convert between group and non-group cost centers.

methods.name: convert_to_group
methods.description: Calls server to convert a ledger to a group.

methods.name: convert_to_ledger
methods.description: Calls server to convert a group to a ledger.
